summary: Configured persistent name-based websites on node1: docs.branch.test and orders.branch.test share TCP 8080, unknown hosts return HTTP 400, approved content remains unchanged, and functionality survived a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Created and enabled the RHEL 7-compatible branch-tenants systemd service using installed Python 2.7.
Mapped each hostname to its corresponding staged content tree.
Opened TCP 8080 in runtime and permanent firewalld configuration.
Rebooted node1 safely and verified complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Both hostnames share TCP port 8080 and serve their assigned trees
evidence.summary: A single 0.0.0.0:8080 listener served exact matching docs and orders index and auxiliary files according to Host.

evidence.requirement: Unknown Host headers receive an error
evidence.summary: Unknown hosts returned HTTP 400 with the Unknown Host marker before and after reboot.
All five staged-file SHA-256 hashes remained identical from the initial baseline through post-reboot verification.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel

evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID bdbfa15c-cfc4-4b36-8edd-d0a49076e9c5 was captured; native reboot was acknowledged; node returned with changed boot ID 7d47767c-6e5f-499b-a607-49d5ed2f947f; service, listener, firewall, content, and host routing all recovered.
